blocks.text: 🪝 Cabinet Approves ₹84,084 Crore 'Samudra Manthan' Offshore Energy Exploration Scheme. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Unlocks India's offshore crude oil and gas potential across Krishna-Godavari, Cauvery, and Mahanadi basins.
Phase-I Outlay: ₹84,084 crore implementation through FY31 under Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas.
Scheme Components: (i) ₹28,534 cr (2D/3D seismic data & NDR AI re-processing); (ii) ₹55,200 cr (drilling 60 deepwater wells); (iii) ₹350 cr (monitoring).
Production Target: Increases domestic oil & gas production from 62 MMTOE to 80 MMTOE annually.
Samudra Manthan Phase-I total outlay (₹84,084 crore) vs deepwater drilling component (₹55,200 crore).
